# ETL Data Pipeline & Reporting Automation

::: {.hero-lead}
A Python-SQL ETL workflow in Snowflake built to standardize multi-source retail and weather data for scalable analysis.
:::

::: {.metrics-grid}
::: {.detail-card}
### Objective
Reduce manual effort and improve reporting consistency across combined datasets.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Methods
Python-SQL ETL design, multi-source standardization, and ZIP-level weather mapping.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Outcome
Created a cleaner pipeline for identifying temperature-driven demand patterns affecting supplier sales.
:::
:::
:::
